summary.text: CVE-2024-3400 is a critical command‑injection vulnerability in Palo Alto Networks PAN‑OS GlobalProtect that can allow unauthenticated remote code execution with root privileges on affected firewalls.

findings.rationale: The CVE has a CVSS v3.1 base score of 10.0 (critical) and is listed in the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) catalog, indicating active exploitation. EPSS assigns a near‑certain exploitation probability (score 0.99999). These factors together warrant immediate attention.
recommended_actions: Apply mitigations per Palo Alto Networks vendor instructions as they become available.
Enable Threat Prevention IDs provided by the vendor for vulnerable devices until a patch is released.
Review the vendor bulletin for the patch release schedule and follow any required configuration changes.
uncertainties: Exact applicability to specific PAN‑OS versions in the environment is unverified; the CVE record lists affected custom version ranges (e.g., 10.2.0‑<10.2.9‑h1, 11.0.0‑<11.0.4‑h1, 11.1.0‑<11.1.2‑h3).
No public patch status is present in the retrieved records; mitigation guidance may change when a fix is issued.

limitations: The investigation relies on the CVE record, CISA KEV entry, and EPSS score available at retrieval time; any later updates are not reflected.
Asset‑specific version information was not provided, so the report cannot confirm whether particular devices are vulnerable.

descriptions:
A command injection as a result of arbitrary file creation vulnerability in the GlobalProtect feature of Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS software for specific PAN-OS versions and distinct feature configurations may enable an unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary code with root privileges on the firewall.

Cloud NGFW, Panorama appliances, and Prisma Access are not impacted by this vulnerability.

entry.vulnerabilityName: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS Command Injection Vulnerability
entry.shortDescription: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS GlobalProtect feature contains a command injection vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated attacker to execute commands with root privileges on the firewall.
entry.requiredAction: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions as they become available. Otherwise, users with vulnerable versions of affected devices should enable Threat Prevention IDs available from the vendor. See the vendor bulletin for more details and a patch release schedule.
